cases.value: Certificate of Authentication, not an apostille
cases.evidence: Washington is not an apostille issuer for federal purposes: the office issues a Certificate of Authentication, not an apostille, for most destinations.
The fee table shows $15 per document for standard authentication. Expedited handling is billed separately per order.
Walk-in customers go to Town Center 3, Tumwater, appointments preferred. Unscheduled visitors are served only when the queue allows.
Mail requests to PO Box 40228 with the order form and fees enclosed. A second PO Box in circulation is superseded and must not be used.
Phone hours are Mon-Fri 8-5 excluding state holidays. Counter service ends thirty minutes before closing.
Authentication questions go to (360) 725-0344. Email replies take two business days.

cases.value: current request form from the office site
cases.evidence: Use the current request form from the office site. The December 2024 revision is superseded and now returns a 404.
Standard processing is five business days from receipt of a complete order. Mailed orders add transit time both ways.

cases.value: notary seal on the document itself
cases.evidence: Documents must carry a notary seal on the document itself. Whether a county pre-step applies is covered by the fifty-state survey.

cases.value: check or money order payable to Secretary of State
cases.evidence: Pay by check or money order payable to Secretary of State. Cash is accepted only at the counter, never by mail.
Bring a current photo ID at pickup. Third-party pickup needs a signed authorization letter plus a copy of the requester ID.
Enclose one photocopy per document for the office file. Originals are returned with the authentication attached.
The office is closed on state holidays and closes early the day before Thanksgiving. The holiday list is posted each November.
